opportunities.point: The company aims to scale the revenue contribution of manufacturing to 50% in the next two to three years.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company expects margins from polymer additives to be around 40%.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Currently, in terms of the manufacturing margins, we are standing at 30% approximately, whereas from polymer additives, we feel that the margins would be 40%." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company is looking to increase its total capacity to 18,000 metric tons in a phased manner over the next 18 months.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Basically, we are looking at total capacity of 18,000 metric tons including all the current capacity and this we are going to increase in the phased manner in the next 18 months." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company acquired a 9.6 acre land to develop its polymer additives and polymer compound facility.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: A chemicals tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The company is currently focusing on the cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment industries for its flame-retardant products.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "This flame-retardant is being used in various industries, but currently, we are focusing on cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to target EV batteries once it caters to the cable, wire, and electrical equipment segments.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Once we cater to these two segments, then we will target EV batteries also." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company's current order book is around Rs. 55 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Currently, order book is around about Rs. 55 crore and it depends upon the customer." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Out of the Rs. 55 crores order book, Rs. 42 crores is from government contracts.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Out of these Rs. 55 crores, Rs. 42 crores is from government and rest is from private." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company will try to file three patents in the next six months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "But in next six months, we will try to file three patents." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company will try to address teething problems in the polymer additives plant in the next three months.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 11 -> 18 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow -3 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -75 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: Borrowings above equity leave limited room if the cycle turns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -1.85 pp, DII -7.2 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Geopolitical scenarios have impacted import trading as the company's three-month stock is getting dried up.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us. So, that stock is getting dried up." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The company's polymer additives plant is experiencing teething problems.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: Raw material prices increased tremendously in February.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "So, we have sourced the material for next six months or suddenly there was demand from December onwards of these raw materials and the prices have increased tremendously in February of these raw materials." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)
